thread:
sam: :rotating_light: Seeing a 502/5xx spike from the hosted inference gateway since ~09:12 UTC. Customers report generation requests failing. Gateway logs show: control-plane auth/session returning 502 and config DB timeouts. Escalating.
liz: Any recent deploys to control-plane or routing service? which model/tenant is most affected?
miguel: Quick query: 09:10-09:20 UTC -> ~1.2k 5xx across tenant=prod, majority origin=hosted-gateway. Top errors: "configdb query timeout" and "session-auth 502 upstream". Attached sample log below.
ops-bot: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/alerts/hosted-gateway/502-spike (hits + rate per tenant) :link:
sam: sample error from gateway logs:
```
[2026-03-17T09:14:03Z] ERROR request_id=req_abc123 upstream=control-plane status=502 detail="session auth: upstream read timeout"
[2026-03-17T09:14:04Z] ERROR request_id=req_def456 upstream=config-db status=504 detail="query exceeded 10s"
```
maya: @miguel can you paste the request_ids for a failing call? we'll look up control-plane traces.
miguel: req_abc123, req_def456, req_xyz789. Traces show control-plane call to configdb timed out after 10s and auth service returned 502 fallback. Trace IDs: traceA/traceB. Logs indicate a sudden spike in long-running config DB queries from routing-policy service.
liz: Could this be the routing-policy change from last night? Was there a topology update to the config schema?
maya: There was a small migration at 02:30 UTC to add a secondary index. Migration reported success but may have caused a brief lock. Looks completed.
sre-lead: Immediate mitigation: enable routing-policy cache fallback for hosted gateway and throttle policy refreshes. Command (prod):
```
redwoodctl config set hosted.gateway.routing.cache_fallback=true --env prod
redwoodctl config set routing.policy.refresh_interval=30s --env prod
```
sam: Repro steps that mirror the spike (done from internal env):
1) curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Tenant: prod" -d '{"model":"open-rlhf","input":"hi"}' --max-time 15
2) flood ~200 concurrent requests -> gateway spikes 502 when control-plane responds slowly
(Attached small script used to repro)
miguel: Quick mitigation applied: increased client timeout to configdb from 10s -> 20s for control-plane candidates. Watch metrics for regression.
ops-bot: Change deployed by miguel at 09:28 UTC. Noted in changelog: repro/mitigation-run-2456789012.
liz: Any billing impact? customers seeing retries causing extra cost?
sam: A couple of heavy customers hit retry loops (noticed elevated token counts). We patched retry logic for internal retryer to backoff earlier for 502s.
maya: Long-term: need to investigate routing-policy query patterns. Possible hot key on policy table from tenant-specific queries. I'll open a follow-up issue with query samples and explain plan.
sre-lead: Next steps:
- Keep cache_fallback enabled until root cause fixed
- Roll back the routing-policy deploy if we see more DB lock signs
- Run explain/analyze on offending configdb queries (miguel + infradb)
- Postmortem if customer impact > 1 hour
If anyone sees fresh 5xx with new request IDs, paste them here.
sam: Thanks — will update thread with any new request_ids and customer PIDs. :thumbsup:
